summary: Full backend regression after monolith→modular refactor (auth/users/feed/messaging/media/demos/admin routers). Seeded a test user + Bearer session directly in Mongo (New York metro, radius=50km) and exercised every endpoint listed in the review request via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 33/33 pytest tests pass — covers root/samples/demos, auth gating (5 protected routes → 401), auth/me with Bearer, feed w/ demo seeding, swipe like/unlike/pass, matches list + unread, translate (en→es 'Hola'), messages send + thread w/ translated_text field, location update + set_home, nearby-radius (10/25/50 → 200, 7/100 → 400), city-position + users/me persistence, GDPR export, report+block, /og/{handle} PNG for existing & non-existing handles, static /api/videos/demo_XX.mp4 with video content-type, cities/popular auth gating, admin endpoints → 403 for non-admin, video/upload rejects text/plain (415). No regressions introduced by the refactor — cross-module dependencies (auth.current_user, demos.seed_demo_users invoked from feed, messaging translate via Emergent LLM) all wire up correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a clean thin entrypoint (~150 lines) — good separation. Startup migrations are idempotent and wrapped in try/except with non-fatal logging.
All routers correctly mounted with /api prefix; StaticFiles for /api/videos, /api/user-videos, /api/share-cards are conditionally mounted (only if dirs exist) which is safe.
Auth dependency (auth.current_user) is properly re-used across users/feed/messaging/media/admin — no duplication.
Consider consolidating the three separate @app.on_event('startup') migration blocks into a single startup hook for cleaner ordering / easier debugging (nit).
models.py exposes CityPositionReq with {city, index} — the frontend contract; verified end-to-end.
test_credentials: TEST session seeded directly in Mongo per /app/memory/test_credentials.md pattern (session_token=TEST_session_<ts>_<uuid>, user_id=TEST_user_<ts>_<uuid>, NYC metro). Auto-cleaned after suite via pytest session fixture teardown (users, user_sessions, swipes, matches, messages, reports, blocks).
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral test user + session per pytest run; all TEST_ prefixed and deleted in fixture teardown. Real demo users (demo-NN) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression.py — reusable for future refactors. It seeds+cleans its own data so it's idempotent. Payload contracts confirmed: /api/users/nearby-radius takes {radius_km:int}, /api/users/me/city-position takes {city:str, index:int}, /api/translate returns {translation, target_lang}, /api/demos/sample returns {demos:[...]}. The refactor is regression-free.
